answer: The vine cap is checked at intake and karst publishes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, since every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a relic tag. That is 10 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
